= DEED grammar fixtures (vendored)

Copied verbatim, SPDX headers intact, from `metadatastician/standards`
`1-formats/deed/tools/fixtures/` at commit
`b2aaeb0c142de45ca1ed6e7b29f548c979737f54` (main, 2026-11-14), where
`deed.abnf` is v2.0.0:

[cols="1,3"]
|===
| Directory | What it holds

| `valid/`, `invalid/`
| the core grammar and the gate's core semantic checks (line length, the
  identity rule, `:schema-version`)

| `heads/valid/`, `heads/invalid/`
| filename dispatch to doc-heads (deed.abnf v1.4.0 J14, v2.0.0 S1)

| `bang/valid/`, `bang/invalid/`
| the bang token (deed.abnf v1.5.0, A7 J17)
|===

`invalid/inno-header_chora.deed` has no SPDX header on purpose: that is the
defect it carries.

`test/deed_conformance_test.exs` requires `Hypatia.Deed.parse/2` to accept
every file under a `valid/` directory and refuse every file under an
`invalid/` one, as `deed_lint.js FILE` does. The clause-profile fixtures
(`anchor/`, `contractiles/`, `ecosystem/`, `edict/`, `egress/`,
`rsr-scorecard/`, `state/`, `verb-descriptile/`) are not vendored here: their
`invalid/` cases are refused by profile flags this reader does not run. The
egress ones are vendored separately, in `../../deed_egress/`.

Hypatia CI has no standards checkout, which is why these are copies. To run the
test against a standards checkout instead, point `HYPATIA_DEED_FIXTURES` (or
the `:hypatia, :deed_standards_fixtures` config key) at its
`1-formats/deed/tools/fixtures` directory. The profile directories are then
read too, and every file under their `valid/` directories must parse.

To refresh: copy the six directories above from a newer standards commit, do
not edit them here, and update the commit in this note.
